legend: You've got a undirected graph G, consisting of n nodes. We will consider the nodes of the graph indexed by integers from 1 to n. We know that each node of graph G is connected by edges with at least k other nodes of this graph. Your task is to find in the given graph a simple cycle of length of at least k + 1.

A simple cycle of length d (d > 1) in graph G is a sequence of distinct graph nodes v1, v2, ..., vd such, that nodes v1 and vd are connected by an edge of the graph, also for any integer i (1 ≤ i < d) nodes vi and vi + 1 are connected by an edge of the graph.
input: The first line contains three integers n, m, k (3 ≤ n, m ≤ 105; 2 ≤ k ≤ n - 1) — the number of the nodes of the graph, the number of the graph's edges and the lower limit on the degree of the graph node. Next m lines contain pairs of integers. The i-th line contains integers ai, bi (1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n; ai ≠ bi) — the indexes of the graph nodes that are connected by the i-th edge.

It is guaranteed that the given graph doesn't contain any multiple edges or self-loops. It is guaranteed that each node of the graph is connected by the edges with at least k other nodes of the graph.
output: In the first line print integer r (r ≥ k + 1) — the length of the found cycle. In the next line print r distinct integers v1, v2, ..., vr (1 ≤ vi ≤ n) — the found simple cycle.
It is guaranteed that the answer exists. If there are multiple correct answers, you are allowed to print any of them.

legend.ai: 给定一个由 n 个节点组成的无向图 G。我们将图中的节点编号为 1 到 n。已知图 G 中的每个节点都至少与图中的 k 个其他节点相连。你的任务是在给定的图中找到一个长度至少为 k + 1 的简单环。
图 G 中长度为 d（d > 1）的简单环是一个由互不相同的图节点 v1, v2, ..., vd 组成的序列，其中节点 v1 和 vd 之间有一条边；并且对于任意整数 i（1 ≤ i < d），节点 vi 和 vi + 1 之间都有一条边。

input.ai: 第一行包含三个整数 n、m、k（3 ≤ n, m ≤ 105；2 ≤ k ≤ n - 1），分别表示图中的节点数、边数以及图中节点度的下限。接下来的 m 行每行包含一对整数。第 i 行包含整数 ai、bi（1 ≤ ai, bi ≤ n；ai ≠ bi），表示第 i 条边连接的图节点编号。
保证给定的图中不含重边或自环。保证图中的每个节点都至少与图中的 k 个其他节点通过边相连。

output.ai: 第一行输出整数 r（r ≥ k + 1）——找到的环的长度。第二行输出 r 个互不相同的整数 v1, v2, ..., vr（1 ≤ vi ≤ n）——找到的简单环。
保证答案存在。如果有多个正确答案，可以输出任意一个。
